label: Activation
subgoals: Set the fault-free value of the site opposite the stuck value
Justify that value back to the primary inputs
Check activation by simulating the fault-free circuit

label: Sensitizing a path
subgoals: Choose a path from the fault site to an output
Set every side input on the path to its non-controlling value
Watch for errors that reconverge and cancel

label: Branch faults and choosing a test
section: Branch faults and choosing a test
subgoals: Propagate a branch fault only through the gate that branch feeds
Check activation and propagation for each candidate vector
Reject vectors that set a side input to its controlling value
